tokens.PLAN_STEPS:
1. Split the page into the rail and the article column.
  2. Move the prose into one card with its headings.
  3. Escape the code sample into a pre block.
  4. Release the files to the guest hosting site.
tokens.ABOUT_BODY: A contents rail, one article, and one code sample. That is the whole documentation starter.
tokens.ABOUT_HOW: Mapped from the sample documentation site by the guest demo, then rebuilt as static files. The prose is first-party copy, not scraped text.
tokens.ARTICLE_BODY: Start the gateway, then point the CLI at it. The article section is the widest column; the rail stays put while you scroll.
